svg.title: A structured model checked against independently written equations
svg.desc: Panel a: largest relative disagreement between a compiled age-by-place model and separately written cell-by-cell equations, on log axes, for NumPy, JAX and PyTorch in float64 and float32, with one marker per test state and evaluator layout; float64 values lie between about ten to the minus fifteen and ten to the minus fourteen and float32 values between about ten to the minus six and five times ten to the minus six, with machine epsilon lines for reference. Panel b: two checks on the model as written and on a copy with its contact matrix indexed the wrong way round. Both pass the population balance check, with residuals near ten to the minus fourteen; only the copy with the transposed matrix fails the comparison with independent equations, with disagreement above one.
